name: @stackra/payments
description: Stackra payments: the gateway ports (checkout, capture, refund, void, saved-token charges with a merchant-initiated flag, payouts, platform onboarding, disputes and terminal sessions with a tip prompt), the PaymentGateways port that picks a provider per tenant and Market through the Connection, the PaymentService with the unknown state and lookup before retry, pay links, the restricted-tender kind (EBT, meal vouchers: line eligibility by rule set, split tender, tax exclusion per pack, capture at fulfilment) and the terminal PIN step, agent payments taken only within the shopper's wallet confirmation (the AgentCommerceProtocols port), the SoftPos tap-to-pay driver family with the Stripe Tap to Pay driver over the app's SDK bridge, pre-authorisation and incremental authorisation on saved tokens, concurrent partial payments against one balance under a lock with an idempotent settle (PaymentBalanceService), four connection modes (oauth-standard, own-key, connected-account with its pre-verification cap and payout hold, legacy-connected-account), the market-pack MarketPaymentDefaults driver and the PaymentsModule (./node); the vendor drivers are connectors in the OS integrations service
